//: Duka build profiles for testable APK distribution.
NOTE: Duka is a native Kotlin/Jetpack Compose app built with Gradle (app/build.gradle.kts,
applicationId = com.duka.app) — not an Expo/React Native project, so `eas build` cannot
compile it as-is. This file follows the requested EAS profile shape so it is ready if the
project gains an Expo shell; today the equivalent cloud path is .github/workflows and the
local path is: ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug  (profile 'preview' == APK, not AAB).
